name: Eldrazi Confluence

labels: Target creature gets +3/-3 until end of turn.
Exile target nonland permanent, then return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control.
Create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."

abilities.text: Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once.

notes: "You may choose the same mode more than once" is the family `choose-modes` with `repeat`; the core `choose-mode` cannot say it (and `legal.ts:modeCombos` enumerates pairs only for a count above 2). The price is that an effect inside a family mode is never offered a target at cast time (docs/vocabulary/piles-choices.md 5), so each "target" clause is a `choose-objects` pick acted on through `that` — chosen as the spell resolves, without the targeting legality checks.

issues: • Target creature gets +3/-3 until end of turn. — expected a target chosen on cast (CR 601.2c), checked for shroud/hexproof/protection and re-checked on resolution — scripted choose-objects {types:[Creature], who:each-player} + pump target:that — no target at all; picked as the spell resolves, bypassing every targeting restriction — CR 115.1, 601.2c

• Exile target nonland permanent, then return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control. — expected a targeted nonland permanent — scripted choose-objects {notTypes:[Land], who:each-player} + move that->exile + move those->battlefield tapped. Zones/tapped/owner are right (opMove's ctlOf defaults to o.owner, game.ts:1790) and 'those' survives the exile (bindingHolds, game.ts:1712), but the target word is again dropped — a hexproof or protected permanent can be blinked — CR 115.1, 400.7

Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once. — expected three modes declared as the spell is cast — scripted family choose-modes count:3 repeat:true — modes are chosen on resolution, not on cast, so opponents never see the choice before responding; the blind scenarios confirm the engine offers no cast that takes a `modes` selection (0/4, all four scenarios error on `cast Eldrazi Confluence` with modes). piles-choices.md §5 states a modal spell whose modes target must use the core `choose-mode`; neither op can express this card in full — CR 700.2, 601.2b

• Create a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." — expected 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion with the sacrifice-for-{C} ability — scripted token 1/1 colors:[] subtypes:[Eldrazi,Scion] spawn:true — the `spawn` flag is exactly 'Sacrifice this token: Add {C}' (_tokens.ts Spawn), so this mode is correct — CR 111.1
